openEnded: This level has no deadline of its own. Deadlines and work limits from the levels above still apply.
bounded: This level's own limits and those of the levels above all apply. The earliest deadline is the one that counts.
softTarget.note: A planning goal; it does not close anything.
grace.note: Submission grace does not extend planning or admission limits.
binding.none: No binding calendar deadline. Work quotas may still constrain expansion.
quotas.empty.title: No finite work quota in this path
quotas.empty.body: Any applicable calendar deadline still governs the scope.
quotas.caption: Work limits on this path and how much is used
why.deadline: What sets this date: {level} ({scope}), {date}. Earlier dates anywhere above always win; a level below can only make it earlier.
why.noDeadline: No calendar date applies here. Only work limits can stop more work being added.

why.group.range: {metric}: {count, plural, one {# concept} other {# concepts}}, limited by {level} ({scope}) — between {min} and {max} left.
